Power tab aati jab tum act choose karte.
Value create karo.
Believe karo tum kar sakte ho—aadha kaam ho gaya.
Chahe 'kar sakta' socho, ya 'nahi'—
Hamare peeche aur aage jo hai, woh humare andar jo hai usse chhota hai.
Winners kabhi quit nahi karte.
Sirf fail woh hai jo try nahi karta.
Grow karo.
Log waqai exceptional tab bante hain jab excuses band karke progress start kar dete hain.
"Seekho. Phir lead karo."
Saara progress comfort zone ke bahar hota.
"Future unka hai jo tayari karte hain."
